why: Agent skills (SKILL.md, an open format every major harness loads) that make a phase better. `dh next` names only the ones installed on this machine, at most four, with why. Names are the skills' own `name:`; add rows freely — nothing breaks when a skill is missing.

define.name: market-compliance
define.why: the market's legal must-haves (consumer law, privacy, licences) known before the plan

research.name: grounded-citations
research.why: every claim with a source you can re-check — what `dh research verify` then proves

research.name: adaptive-web-research
research.why: search that adapts to blocked or thin sources

research.name: competitor-news-monitor
research.why: what the named competitors changed recently

research.name: blocked-page-recovery
research.why: a competitor page that 403s or hides behind a wall

plan.name: oss-reuse-evaluation
plan.why: judge a base or library before it enters the plan (licence, health, fit)

plan.name: marketplace-booking-pipelines
plan.why: the request → confirm → pay flow for a marketplace or booking shape

plan.name: multilingual-web-apps
plan.why: routes, RTL and message files when the brief has several languages

plan.name: spike
plan.why: a throwaway experiment when one feature's feasibility is unknown

build.name: test-driven-development
build.why: each feature lands with the test that proves it

build.name: systematic-debugging
build.why: root cause before a fix when the build breaks

build.name: browser-e2e-testing
build.why: the planned forms and flows exercised in a real browser before G2

brand.name: humanizer
brand.why: copy that reads like a person wrote it — then `dh slop check` proves it

brand.name: design-md

brand.name: popular-web-designs
brand.why: proven design systems to borrow structure from

brand.name: claude-design
brand.why: a one-off designed page or section when nothing licensed fits

tryon.name: design-md

review.name: dogfood

review.name: browser-e2e-testing

review.name: requesting-code-review

review.name: market-compliance
